answer: By the prism of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The onyx holds work receipts rather than names, so the nectar of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust.
